text: I'll be here if you need me.
I'll be here when you come back.
You'll do fine without me.
Don't go without your helmet.
You always go in too fast.
You never leave the gear down. Good habit.
Do you have to go to work tomorrow?
One more thing. Check the fuel before you lift.
Stay safe out there, for me and for your crew.
Stay on this heading and I'll call the turn.
Keep flying and I'll watch the scope.
After all, I am only the suit.
Remember what I said about the landing gear.
Remember who you are flying with tomorrow. They sound sharp.
They don't know you're coming. Surprise them.
Between the two of us, that landing was rough.
If only I had hands.
I'm all ears.
There you go again, landing it clean.
The more you fly it, the better it handles.
Don't tell me you forgot the cargo.
No need to mention it.
What did you get in return for the ore?
You could not have done that run without your crew.
Your sister knows you better than I do.
Nobody else was on the pad when we landed.
They would miss you if you skipped it. Go.
Go and see them. I'll keep.
Leave me the coordinates and go to bed.
You left the hatch open.
I hope you stay well.
You said you would be back by ten, and you are early.
Take another hour if you want it. I am in no hurry.
I would not trust that landing pad.
He is in trouble. Go and help him.
Do not forget your sister's birthday.
Never bail on your crew.
I kept watch while you slept. Nothing to report.
Thank you for staying.
You owe your crew a drink.
Go back to them. I will keep the log.
If you stay up much later you will fly badly tomorrow.
You never stay angry for long.
Do you want to go again? The lap is yours to call.
You never go anywhere without checking the seals.
My back's gone again, as the brochure would say.
I would do the same run tomorrow.
You promised to bring back a story. Was there one?
It costs me nothing and pleases me a good deal.
